findings.evidence: `rg "TauCeti.Sym.toFn|TauCeti.Sym.ofFn_toFn" code/TauCeti` finds uses only in `LinearAlgebra/SymmetricPower/Basis.lean`, besides their declarations.
findings.fix: Keep the chosen section private to `SymmetricPower.Basis` (or replace it with a local choice argument) and remove `toFn`/`ofFn_toFn` from the public `Sym` API.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.Sym.toFn` publicly exposes an arbitrary, choice-dependent ordering although its docstring says only `ofFn_toFn` should be used; its only repository consumers are basis-construction internals.

findings.evidence: Lines 115–160 expose the coordinate map and equivalence before defining `Basis.symmetricPower := Basis.ofRepr (linearEquivFinsupp n b)`; `rg` shows no consumers outside this file.
findings.fix: Make these construction helpers private, retaining `Basis.symmetricPower`, `Basis.symmetricPower_apply`, and externally meaningful coordinate lemmas stated through `(b.symmetricPower n).repr`.
findings.issue: `toFinsupp`, `toFinsupp_tprod_basis`, `linearEquivFinsupp`, and `linearEquivFinsupp_symm_single` expose the internal construction of `Basis.symmetricPower`; the resulting basis already provides the canonical `repr` equivalence and basis-vector accessor.

summary: The canonical basis and lift APIs are useful, but the PR publicly exposes several proof-construction artifacts and a noncanonical ordering choice that have no independent external role.
